en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European street scene. It shows a cobbled square with early 20th‑century pedestrians in long coats and hats walking among tall, narrow buildings with shutters and shop signs. A distinctive overhanging corner building stands on the left, while a small kiosk or pavilion is located in the middle of the square. The scene is framed by multi‑story façades leading toward a building at the far end. Printed caption text appears in Italian at the bottom border.
